scope:
Short, owned solo check of saved settings/Voice UMG, without audio capture.

Run after the approved build and author_voice_ui.py, through RunOwnedEditor.ps1.
Reuses the existing settings check and its preference/graphics/editor restoration.
Never opens a microphone, starts a mic test, connects peers or sends voice. Actual
runtime window frames are captured separately from explicitly labelled Designer
indicator examples. Optional MC_VOICE_UI_OUTPUT environment variable selects a
fresh output directory on E:.
limitations: Local solo PIE; no packaged game or multiplayer.
Normal callbacks/control setters are used; physical input is not injected.
Audio routing/gains are checked; this silent capture is not a listening test.
Display resolution and mode are kept unchanged; rollback is covered by native tests.
Mic test/device-settings buttons are inspected but never clicked; no microphone stream is opened.
Rebind starts via the actual button and cancels through normal menu StopInteraction. Physical key delivery/new-key acceptance is outside this Python check.
Voice gain independence checks preference/routing math; a silent solo run cannot verify remote playback.
Indicator animation PNGs are labelled Designer examples, not real talker audio. Runtime only checks the real inactive state; no fake talking flag is set.
The MainMenu map may have no character/indicator component. Absence is reported, not a gameplay assertion.
